style: Premium TV-broadcast opener. Deep navy LED wall (fine pixel grid + scanlines + a slow scan band), warm orange radial glow that breathes, drifting light motes. Logo assembles at the top, then heavy Montserrat Black kinetic type hits on the narrator's words. Confident and punchy, never cartoonish.
font: Montserrat variable 100-900 (local woff2, latin + latin-ext split by unicode-range)
block: none (hand-authored; logo choreography reused from tebrik-2026/hyperframes/kapanis-logo)

catalog_searched: LED pixel grid scanline background texture -> yt-lcd-background (paper board, wrong material), dynamic-grid (SaaS grid); hand-authored CSS LED grid instead
date hero slam with glow flash -> caption-kinetic-slam (full-screen single word), editorial-flash-overlay (cut flash); idiom reused, hand-authored for voice sync
stamp text impact underline -> hw-underline, lt-accent-underline (draw-on rules); stamp frame + ring hand-authored
logo assembly sting -> logo-sting, logo-outro (generic); the client's own kapanis-logo choreography reused per brief
rules: ambient-glow-bloom (breathing glow, inhale before the date hit, flash on impact)
motion-vocabulary: letter rise (wordmark, KASIM), tracking-in (ANKARA KAMPI), underline_sweep, fade_blur (HAZIRLIKLAR), slide_out + blur (exit)
